classification: Owner playtest only; game design, not registered biology

D.name: middle
D.selection: Lowest amplitude whose pooled median completed visible walking bout is at least 0.3 s on seeds 101..104; drop if none

C.name: busy, quicker takeoff
C.selection: Lowest speed with bot 4 unrestricted flick catch rate <= 0.65 on seeds 101..104, six opportunities per seed; drop if none. All candidates retained.
C.physics_disclosure: Takeoff speed is an abstract body-physics game parameter, not a neural parameter. Duration, heading, jitter, onset and reflection rules remain v2.7.

drive_protocol: profiles/walking-grid-v1.json (algorithm and stream unchanged; a01 target gate remains FAIL)

measurement.visible_path: Trailing 200 ms boxcar average of body position; derivative at 10 ms = displacement from t-200 ms to t / 200 ms. No future samples. Initial 200 ms and any window containing airborne movement are excluded.
measurement.visible_walking: Smoothed grounded speed > 0.5 fly lengths/s; maximal contiguous bouts/stops; exclude left/right/air-gap censored segments from medians, retain them. Speed median over visible walking intervals.
measurement.decoded_walking: Same a01: grounded absolute applied forward >= 0.002 arena units/ms; completed bouts/stops, speed and fraction retained.
measurement.coverage: Same a01 2-unit cells, 37 centers within arena, grounded positions only
measurement.bot_1: Observe current body position; aim there after any reaction delay
measurement.bot_2: Observe body position and current held translational velocity; lead by velocity times strike fall time; add same delay/noise rules as bot 1
measurement.bot_4: After warmup/gap, observe consecutive 150 ms grounded body intervals with speed <= 0.5 fly lengths/s (rotation in place allowed); then aim at observed position after any reaction delay. No forced stop.

human_like.noise_rule: Existing bot stream 71: independent uniform +/-0.3 on x/y, u32(neural_seed,71,opportunity,axis); identical across presets

measurement.bot_boundary: Project aim just inside circular boundary, identical deterministic rounding guard as a01
measurement.bot_censoring: Six opportunities per 30 s round; censor if no still interval/impact by round end. Catch rate uses resolved impacts; report censored separately and no attempt count substituted for resolved count.
measurement.resting_swat: Exact a01 schedule: 20 neural seeds x two independent five-strike rounds. Environment seed 1000+seed+100*round. Before each swat wait for 200 ms grounded below original moving deadbands (absolute forward < .002, absolute turn < .0005). Neural state persists across the five strikes; no force-stop. Each round retains the original 30 s limit.
measurement.resting_swat_censoring: Any unresolved opportunity counts as a nonescape for the conservative safety probability, while resolved-only escape and censoring are also reported.
measurement.speed_summary: Median pooled interval speeds during each walking definition; per-seed medians also reported

safety.resting_swat_comparison: Conservative escape probability over all 200 scheduled opportunities >= original matched a01 v2.7 176/200 = 0.88. A rerun must reproduce the original v2.7 control. Prior independent-round results are descriptive only.
safety.replay: Exact reexecution digest with effective profile identity, no gaps
safety.parity: Bit-exact Python/TypeScript drive currents and state for every preset over 3000 intervals; reset and neural parity retained

offering_rule: A/B fixed, D/C chosen only by their declared rules; offer only presets passing every safety gate. No speed/bout/bot target otherwise. Owner chooses feel by playing.

preview.production: No preview module, preset data or URL activation path in production bundle; ordinary production v2.7 unchanged

per_offered_preset: bot 4 unrestricted flick, warmup 1.5 s then stop-150 ms pattern with 1 s gaps; continue round after recorded replay

copy.game: The wiring model does not walk on its own. The game adds a declared random drive to the walking neurons (game profile v2.8). Escape comes only from vision through the network.
copy.lab: Lab simulations have no walking drive.

amendment: decisions/D-V2J-PROTOCOL-04.json: restore exact a01 repeated-strike workload for the safety comparison; retained D-V2J-PROTOCOL-03 and all prior records.
